chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 270: The Inn – A Town Drowning in Fear
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s group takes shelter in a strange inn. The locals are terrified of outsiders, and Lü Zhuangyuan’s attempt to bribe the cook for answers ends in panicked flight. What happened here?
og_title: Chapter 270: The Inn – Something Happened in This Town
og_description: A warm inn, a crying baby, and a cook who throws away silver like it’s poison. Li Huowang’s rest stop hides a secret no one will speak aloud.
twitter_title: The cook ran like the devil was after him. What happened in this town?
twitter_description: Everyone in this town is terrified of outsiders. Li Huowang wants to know why—but the innkeeper won’t talk. Chapter 270 of Dao Gui Yi Xian.

lore_anchors.definition: The group’s loyal dog; named after a steamed bun, a common rural pet name in China.
A folk method to boost lactation; pig trotter and crucian carp soup is a traditional Chinese remedy for nursing mothers.
A historical term for a scholar who has passed the first level of the imperial examination; used here as a baby’s name, reflecting Lü Juren’s academic aspirations for his son.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the waiter and cook so afraid of Li Huowang’s group?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The townsfolk are reacting to a recent traumatic event (or ongoing supernatural threat) that has made them terrified of all outsiders. Li Huowang himself is also a walking uncanny valley, even if he doesn’t realize it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Lü Zhuangyuan try to bribe the cook?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In jianghu culture, bribing or 'gifting' small amounts of silver is a normal way to open conversations and gain trust. When the silver is rejected with fear, it signals the problem is deeper than simple greed.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the dog (Mantou) really named after a steamed bun?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, in rural and folk Chinese culture, people often name their dogs after food items (e.g., Mantou, Tofu) as a term of endearment. It’s meant to be humble and cute.
